grading_cap_rationale: A single grade covers multiple responses and seven or more verdicts per response; JSON verdicts and verified quotes cannot reliably fit 768 tokens.
estimate_basis: Pilot #309 means: 15424 raw / 331 content per interpretation, 16145 raw / 1052 content per one-response grade; add 500 tokens for each additional response graded. Estimates only, actual usage recorded per call; separately budget authoring, quote regrades, failures and #318 attack calls.
accounting: Per-call content = reported input minus same-session minimal-prompt overhead plus reported output; record raw and content, latency and retries. Unknown failed-call usage stops the candidate.
authoring: Independent fresh case author calls are additional and reported separately, including excluded contaminated author runs.
